> BuildSafe is an ESP32-based hardware monitoring device designed to track environmental and motion-related conditions around building structures. It combines temperature, humidity, tilt/vibration sensing, local data logging, and real-time alerts to help identify unusual changes that may require inspection. This warm-up project is a compact prototype of a larger construction-safety monitoring system I am developing.
